dateline: El Paso, Texas — BTS Pre-Concert Day; Busan June Shows Sold Out; HYBE Posts Record $478M Q1 Revenue
heroHeadline: Day 4,705: BTS Sets Up for Historic El Paso Debut — Busan Sellout and HYBE's Record $478M Quarter Underscore Reunion Momentum
heroSubtitle: May 1, 2026 is Day 4,705 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS is in pre-concert preparation in El Paso, Texas ahead of their ARIRANG World Tour shows at Sun Bowl Stadium on May 2–3 — the group's first-ever performances in El Paso and the US–Mexico border region. Both nights are sold out, with fans traveling from West Texas, New Mexico, and Ciudad Juárez. On April 30, V shared exclusive backstage photos from the Tampa Florida leg, and Busan Asiad Main Stadium shows (June 12–13, 2026 — the group's 13th debut anniversary) sold out during fan club presale. HYBE's Q1 2026 results confirm record revenue of 698.3 billion KRW ($478M USD), a 39.5% year-over-year surge driven by 'ARIRANG' and the World Tour. 'SWIM' continues charting on the Billboard Hot 100 as the tour progresses.
